candidates.description: The 1‑cv treatment is the monoculture of the choice cultivar (AB‑2) grown alone in each subplot.
The 3‑cv treatment combines the choice cultivar AB‑2 with two additional cultivars (CXD‑179 and H‑8892) in each subplot.
The 5‑cv treatment includes all five cultivars (AB‑2, CXD‑179, H‑8892, H‑2601, Red Spring) together in each subplot.
